description: Personal portfolio website for Jordano Giacomet Tomazoni — software engineer and full-stack developer focused on web products, automation, and applied AI. Single-page scrolling site built with Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS. Dark editorial premium aesthetic inspired by luxury portfolio layouts with burgundy tones, cream contrast, strong typography, modular cards, and high perceived sophistication. Content hardcoded via JSON files.

designDirection.aesthetic: Dark editorial premium — burgundy and cream, elegant but technical. Strong typography, modular sections, luxury-inspired composition, and restrained motion. NOT light mode.

typography.display: Playfair Display or equivalent editorial serif — used for hero title, section titles, and premium headlines.
typography.body: DM Sans or Inter — used for navigation, body copy, labels, metadata, and UI elements.
typography.accent: Italic serif or medium sans — used for taglines, emphasis, and section subtitles.

designPrinciples: Editorial layout — sections feel like curated presentation cards, not a generic SaaS landing page
Premium contrast — burgundy dark backgrounds with cream surfaces and careful accent usage
Typography-driven — oversized serif headings and disciplined sans-serif body copy
Modular composition — cards, framed content blocks, and image anchors
Whitespace and rhythm — sections must breathe and feel intentional
Case-study presentation — projects shown as outcomes, not just thumbnails
Motion with restraint — Framer Motion used for scroll-driven reveal and depth, not visual noise
Trust and seriousness — visuals must communicate engineering depth and execution quality

userStories.description: Execute a performance optimization pass focused on render cost, animation smoothness, image loading, and bundle size without changing the visual identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit initial page load, image usage, hydration cost, and scroll smoothness

Review client component boundaries and reduce them when possible
Ensure animations remain performant on mid-range devices
Improve image sizing and loading behavior where necessary
Document findings in progress.txt in a dedicated performance block

functionalRequirements: FR-1: Built with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript
FR-2: Styled with Tailwind CSS using a dark editorial premium theme
FR-3: All content stored in JSON files under data/ directory
FR-4: Navbar supports smooth scroll between sections
FR-5: Fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop
FR-6: Project cards link to live demos and/or GitHub
FR-7: Contact form validates inputs client-side before showing success state
FR-8: Semantic HTML elements throughout for accessibility
FR-9: Framer Motion for scroll-driven and entrance animations; CSS transitions for hover states and micro-interactions
FR-10: Static export for deployment flexibility
FR-12: Visual identity must feel premium, structured, and technically credible
nonGoals: No backend server or database in v1
No blog or writing section in v1
No light/dark theme toggle in v1
